title: LINK with a COMMAREA shorter than, longer than, or absent from what the callee declares; LINK to an undefined program

scenarios.summary: LENGTH(100) to a callee declaring 500 bytes: EIBCALEN 100, the callee leaves the extension alone
LENGTH(500) naming a 100-byte item: the callee addresses 500 bytes of the caller's storage and its writes to the extension land in the caller's WS-AFTER
LINK without COMMAREA: EIBCALEN 0, the callee must not touch DFHCOMMAREA
LINK to a program with no definition (autoinstall off): PGMIDERR, RESP2 1, caught by RESP
